entries.summary: Acts first in initiative, fails its Grease Dexterity save and tumbles prone down the stairs. Its initially successful Snare Dexterity save is rerolled with disadvantage because it is falling prone: 4 fails, so the snare hoists it upside down and restrained.
Approaches with both short swords: 16 misses and 17 hits for 7 damage. Her bird swarm deals another 1 damage.
Runs up and slashes twice with daggers at advantage; one attack hits on 22. Corrects damage to 3 by removing the inapplicable +2, then backs away without safely disengaging.
Makes an opportunity swing at the retreating Acescale with disadvantage from restraint; 13 misses.

Eldritch Blast hits with advantage on 18 and deals substantial force damage, leaving the hobgoblin badly wounded. The DM includes its head cracking against the stairs in the same damage rather than granting extra damage.
entries.note: No numerical damage total is spoken.

entries.summary: Uses his bonus action to command Steampup to attack after him, then misses his own attack despite advantage from restraint. Describes holding back to avoid cutting the snare.
Attacks with advantage. Its damage modifier is corrected from +3 to +2; 10 damage is enough to kill the hobgoblin. It grabs the neck, throws the body beside the torch, and stands over it.

ending.summary: Steampup kills the restrained smokebinder and stands over it. The next exchange begins corpse inspection and scouting for the guard above.

combats.encounter: Second hobgoblin at the reset crypt trap
combats.note: The DM waives a fresh initiative roll, resolves the guard first and allows the party to act in any order. This encounter ends during its first ordered cycle.

entries.summary: Fails the Grease Dexterity save, falls down the stairs for 6 damage, then fails the Snare Dexterity save with disadvantage on 7 and is hoisted restrained. Shoots Gaudin at disadvantage (18 and 17): the hit deals 8 piercing damage and ignites him. An action can extinguish the fire; otherwise fire damage occurs at the end of his turn.
Attacks with advantage from restraint and reports a natural 20 on the second roll. The table doubles critical damage and the guard is nearly dead; no damage total or weapon is spoken.
entries.note: A separate short-sword sequence is then introduced as Loria’s. The source does not settle whether the preceding speaker label is mistaken; no other PC is substituted.

entries.summary: Moves in with a short sword and reports 5, then takes a second attack and reports 17. The next dialogue treats the guard as defeated, but no damage or final blow is explicitly resolved.
entries.note: The value 5 is not clearly an attack roll or damage. The second attack’s hit and damage are not explicitly stated.

entries.summary: Uses his action to put out his own fire; no continuing fire damage is reported.

ending.summary: The party counts the second guard defeated; the crypt is quiet and Gaudin’s warning ring is dark. The source does not narrate a precise killing blow.

limitations: The post-break recording gap before u1211 contains no surviving combat turns. The dated Labyrinths of the Lost - Session 2 note describes an additional ruined-library fight in that interval; its actions, actors and rounds cannot be reconstructed from this registered transcript.
